final: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT z.city, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count FROM attendance AS a JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN zip_code AS z ON z.zip_code = m.zip GROUP BY z.city), city_shares AS (SELECT attendance_count, 1.0 * attendance_count / SUM(attendance_count) OVER () AS share FROM city_counts), shares_with_average AS (SELECT attendance_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM city_shares) SELECT AVG(attendance_count) AS average_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares_with_average WHERE share > overall_average_share
